questions.explanation: 根据下文Jim采取了“故意让作者输”、“告诉对手作者弱点”等不同寻常的训练方法，可知他不仅教作者打球，还教作者用与众不同的方式思考（think differently）。
questions.supplement:
A(differently)：语境句：We need to think differently to solve this complex problem. 固定搭配：think differently, behave differently
B(logically)：语境句：He argued logically and convinced everyone. 固定搭配：think logically, reason logically
C(thoroughly)：语境句：The police searched the house thoroughly. 固定搭配：thoroughly investigate, thoroughly enjoy
D(seriously)：语境句：You must take this matter seriously. 固定搭配：take seriously, seriously injured

questions.explanation: 下文教练提到“You're concentrating on grunting(发出哼声)”，grunting属于发出声音/噪音，因此选noises（发出噪音）。
questions.supplement:
A(mistakes)：语境句：Everyone makes mistakes when learning a new language. 固定搭配：make mistakes, learn from mistakes
B(noises)：语境句：The old engine started making strange noises. 固定搭配：make noises, background noise
C(gestures)：语境句：He made rude gestures at the driver who cut him off. 固定搭配：hand gestures, make a gesture
D(faces)：语境句：The little boy was making funny faces at his sister. 固定搭配：make faces, pull a face

questions.explanation: 作者先是回答了“no”（没生病），然后羞涩地“补充（added）”说听说这样发声能增加力量。hesitated（犹豫），repeated（重复），played（玩耍）均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(hesitated)：语境句：She hesitated for a moment before agreeing to the plan. 固定搭配：hesitate to do, without hesitating
B(repeated)：语境句：The teacher repeated the question for the student. 固定搭配：repeat oneself, repeat after me
C(added)：语境句：He smiled and added that he was happy to help. 固定搭配：add to, add up
D(played)：语境句：The children played outside until it got dark. 固定搭配：play a role, play against

questions.explanation: 教练接着说“You're not doing any better with it.”（你并没有因此打得更好），说明作者认为哼声能增加力量的想法是完全错误的（wrong）。
questions.supplement:
A(correct)：语境句：Make sure your answers are entirely correct. 固定搭配：correct answer, absolutely correct
B(wrong)：语境句：It is wrong to judge people by their appearance. 固定搭配：go wrong, entirely wrong
C(creative)：语境句：She is a highly creative designer with unique ideas. 固定搭配：creative thinking, highly creative
D(sensitive)：语境句：Teenagers are often highly sensitive to criticism. 固定搭配：sensitive to, highly sensitive

questions.explanation: 教练批评作者：你的注意力都集中在发声上，而不是集中在“击球（hitting）”上。与前文的“when I hit”呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(hitting)：语境句：He spent the whole afternoon hitting the tennis ball against the wall. 固定搭配：hit the ball, hit hard
B(jumping)：语境句：The kids were jumping up and down with excitement. 固定搭配：jump up, jump at the chance
C(picking)：语境句：She is picking fresh strawberries in the garden. 固定搭配：pick up, pick out
D(running)：语境句：He goes running every morning to stay fit. 固定搭配：running water, up and running

questions.explanation: 根据前文“I played my first competition when I was six.”以及下文“certain I was going to win”，作者已经“练习（practising）”了近两年，所以觉得肯定能赢。
questions.supplement:
A(complaining)：语境句：Customers were complaining about the poor service. 固定搭配：complain about, complain of
B(changing)：语境句：The weather in this region is constantly changing. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change into
C(recalling)：语境句：He had trouble recalling the details of the accident. 固定搭配：recall doing something, beyond recall
D(practising)：语境句：She spends hours practising the piano every day. 固定搭配：practise doing, out of practice

questions.explanation: 后文提到“There aren't many lessons to be learned from an easy win.”（轻松的胜利学不到多少东西），所以教练是故意让作者“输（lose）”。
questions.supplement:
A(defend)：语境句：Troops were sent to defend the borders of the country. 固定搭配：defend against, defend oneself
B(win)：语境句：We are confident that our team will win the match. 固定搭配：win a prize, win over
C(lose)：语境句：If you don't practice, you will lose the game. 固定搭配：lose weight, lose one's way
D(regret)：语境句：I regret to inform you that your application was rejected. 固定搭配：regret doing, express regret

questions.explanation: 教练为了确保作者输掉比赛，故意找了一个“有经验的（experienced）”女孩来把作者打得落花流水。
questions.supplement:
A(experienced)：语境句：We need an experienced programmer for this complex project. 固定搭配：highly experienced, experienced in
B(ambitious)：语境句：He is an ambitious young lawyer who wants to be a partner. 固定搭配：highly ambitious, overly ambitious
C(outgoing)：语境句：Her outgoing personality makes her popular among colleagues. 固定搭配：outgoing personality, friendly and outgoing
D(informed)：语境句：Consumers should make informed choices when buying products. 固定搭配：keep someone informed, informed decision

questions.explanation: 作者11岁时越级与14岁的女孩“竞争/比赛（competing）”，符合体育比赛的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(observing)：语境句：The scientists are closely observing the behavior of the monkeys. 固定搭配：observe closely, observe the law
B(doubting)：语境句：I am doubting whether he is telling the truth. 固定搭配：without doubt, reason for doubting
C(competing)：语境句：Several companies are competing for the same contract. 固定搭配：compete against, compete for
D(waiting)：语境句：I have been waiting for the bus for over half an hour. 固定搭配：wait for, keep someone waiting

questions.explanation: 教练去告诉对手如何打败作者，因为他“知道（knew）”只有导致失败，作者才会更加关注自己的弱点。
questions.supplement:
A(warned)：语境句：The weather report warned of heavy rain tonight. 固定搭配：warn someone about, warn against
B(heard)：语境句：I heard that you are moving to a new city. 固定搭配：hear of, hear from
C(guessed)：语境句：He correctly guessed the answer to the riddle. 固定搭配：guess right, keep someone guessing
D(knew)：语境句：She knew exactly what to say to comfort her friend. 固定搭配：know about, know for sure

questions.explanation: 教练告诉对手去打作者的低位正手，这是作者的“弱点（weaknesses）”。只有输球，作者才会重视自己的弱点。
questions.supplement:
A(scores)：语境句：The final scores were displayed on the large screen. 固定搭配：high scores, settle a score
B(weaknesses)：语境句：Every system has its strengths and weaknesses. 固定搭配：overcome weaknesses, human weakness
C(balls)：语境句：The children were throwing snow balls at each other. 固定搭配：play ball, catch the ball
D(strengths)：语境句：You should choose a career that plays to your strengths. 固定搭配：inner strength, build strength

questions.explanation: 后文教练说“One day you'll catch her.”（总有一天你会赶上她的），再结合“finally, I did”，说明作者当时一直试图“追赶（catching）”她却总是输。
questions.supplement:
A(missing)：语境句：He is missing his family while studying abroad. 固定搭配：go missing, missing from
B(beating)：语境句：He was accused of severely beating the stray dog. 固定搭配：take a beating, beating heart
C(inspiring)：语境句：The leader's speech was incredibly inspiring to the team. 固定搭配：an inspiring story, highly inspiring
D(catching)：语境句：The police are catching the suspect who ran away. 固定搭配：catch up with, catch sight of

questions.explanation: 作者总是输给同一个对手，教练喜欢看到作者被这样“挑战（challenged）”，直到作者急得哭出来。
questions.supplement:
A(praised)：语境句：The teacher praised the student for his excellent work. 固定搭配：praise someone for, highly praised
B(blamed)：语境句：He blamed his failure on bad luck. 固定搭配：blame someone for, take the blame
C(challenged)：语境句：Students need to be challenged to reach their full potential. 固定搭配：feel challenged, strongly challenged
D(respected)：语境句：He is a highly respected doctor in the local community. 固定搭配：highly respected, widely respected

questions.explanation: 终于打败那个女孩后，作者带着惊讶又满足的表情“转向（turned to）”教练，期待得到认可。
questions.supplement:
A(turned to)：语境句：When she was in trouble, she turned to her parents for help. 固定搭配：turn to someone, turn to page...
B(looked after)：语境句：She stayed at home and looked after her sick mother. 固定搭配：look after oneself, well looked after
C(talked about)：语境句：They enthusiastically talked about their recent trip to Paris. 固定搭配：talk about something, widely talked about
D(aimed at)：语境句：The new policy is aimed at reducing unemployment. 固定搭配：aim at doing, specifically aimed at

questions.explanation: 前文提到“There aren't many lessons to be learned...”，结尾总结说，无论输赢，教练教给作者的这些宝贵的“教训/经验（lessons）”都在持续影响她。
questions.supplement:
A(answers)：语境句：The students eagerly shouted out the answers. 固定搭配：find answers, correct answers
B(wishes)：语境句：We send our best wishes for your future happiness. 固定搭配：best wishes, express wishes
C(lessons)：语境句：He learned valuable lessons from his previous failures. 固定搭配：learn a lesson, teach someone a lesson
D(arguments)：语境句：They had fierce arguments over how to spend the money. 固定搭配：get into arguments, strong arguments

section_2_word_form.passage:
In the splendid history of Chinese ceramics(陶瓷制品), there is a name that shines brilliantly — Jingdezhen. This ancient porcelain capital [56] the glory and heritage of a thousand years of porcelain culture.

Jingdezhen was formerly known as Xinping and got its name because the porcelain ware made for the court in the Jingde period of the Song dynasty [57] "Made in the Jingde period". Since then, the reputation of Jingde has spread through the country, becoming related to Chinese ceramics. The [58] of porcelain produced here is vast and of superb quality. For example, the elegant and delicate Yingqing porcelain with [59] mixture of blue and white colors resembles a painting from a fairyland.

During the Ming and Qing [60], Jingdezhen became the center [61] the national porcelain industry, attracting countless skilled craftsmen to contribute talents, and their porcelain-making techniques, [62] promoted Jingdezhen porcelain to unprecedented heights in terms of craftsmanship shape and decoration.

Today, Jingdezhen still maintains its [63] position in the Chinese ceramics industry. Stepping into Jingdezhen is like entering a living epic of ceramics. The ancient kiln fire's(窑火的) exquisite craftsmanship [64] generations of creativity have [65] formed the glory and heritage of this millennium porcelain capital.

questions.explanation: 句子缺谓语动词，主语“This ancient porcelain capital”为单数，讲述客观事实或当前状态，用一般现在时，故填carries。
questions.supplement: 正确形(carries)：语境句：This ancient tradition carries great cultural significance. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on。原词carry其它变形：carrier(n. 载体/搬运工), carry-on(adj. 可随身携带的)

questions.explanation: 因为在宋朝景德年间为宫廷制作的瓷器“被命名为”‘景德年制’，表示过去发生的被动动作，用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was named)：语境句：The new library was named after the generous donor. 固定搭配：be named after, be named as。原词name其它变形：namely(adv. 即，也就是), unnamed(adj. 未命名的)

questions.explanation: The ... of... 结构中缺名词。vary的名词形式为variety。The variety of 意为“……的种类”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(variety)：语境句：The supermarket offers a wide variety of fresh fruits. 固定搭配：a variety of, wide variety。原词vary其它变形：various(adj. 各种各样的), invariably(adv. 总是，不变地)

questions.explanation: 修饰名词mixture，需要用形容词性物主代词its，指代前文的“Yingqing porcelain”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(its)：语境句：The company is famous for its innovative products. 固定搭配：in its own right, on its own。原词it其它变形：itself(pron. 它自己)

questions.explanation: 由“the Ming and Qing”可知这里指明清两个朝代，故用复数形式dynasties。
questions.supplement: 正确形(dynasties)：语境句：Many ancient dynasties contributed to the rich history of China. 固定搭配：ancient dynasties, successive dynasties。原词dynasty无常见词缀变形。

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配“the center of...”，意为“……的中心”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(of)：语境句：New York City is often considered the financial center of the world. 固定搭配：the center of, instead of。无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是“porcelain-making techniques”（物），在从句中作主语，故填关系代词which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He passed the difficult exam, which made his parents very happy. 固定搭配：in which, of which。无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 修饰名词position需要形容词，lead的形容词形式为leading，意为“领先的，主导的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(leading)：语境句：She played a leading role in the successful completion of the project. 固定搭配：leading role, leading position。原词lead其它变形：leader(n. 领导者), leadership(n. 领导力)

questions.explanation: 连接两个并列的主语成分“exquisite craftsmanship”与“generations of creativity”，表示并列关系，填and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：Hard work and determination are the keys to success. 固定搭配：both... and..., back and forth。无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 修饰动词 formed 需要用副词形式，joint的副词为jointly，意为“共同地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(jointly)：语境句：The project was jointly funded by several international organizations. 固定搭配：jointly owned, jointly developed。原词joint其它变形：joint(adj. 共同的 / n. 关节)
